tasks.label: Rojo: serve (live sync to Roblox Studio)
tasks.command: if curl -s --max-time 2 http://localhost:34872/api/rojo | grep -aq 'pretty-pink-tower'; then echo 'Rojo for pretty-pink-tower is already running - live sync is active.'; else pid=$(lsof -ti tcp:34872); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo 'Switching Rojo over from the other game...'; kill $pid; sleep 1; fi; rojo serve; fi
